say:1:1422010001:0.text: It's turned out perfectly! Let's call it... Flamefern Brew!
say:1:1422010001:0.source_cn: 成功了，新鲜出炉的……就叫它火鳞酿！

say:2:1422010002:0.text: Wanna give it a try, Zanie? See if it suits your taste. Jim and Duluth! How can I forget you two—
say:2:1422010002:0.source_cn: 怎么样，祖娅，来试试吧？看看符不符合矮人的口味！吉姆和...

say:5:1422010004:1.text: I'll drink it if Zanie thinks it's good!
say:5:1422010004:1.source_cn: 对！祖娅先尝，要是没问题我再尝！

say:7:1422010006:0.text: Is it really good... or really bad?

say:9:1422010008:0.text: How should I put this? It's better than the last one, though. The fragrance of the flamefern leaves is quite pleasant at first, but then an overwhelming sweetness kicks in!
say:9:1422010008:0.source_cn: 这味道怎么说呢……比上一次强点，刚入口的时候火麟草叶片...

say:10:1422010009:0.text: It feels like I've dipped my entire mouth into a jar of honey for three days!
say:10:1422010009:0.source_cn: 我的口腔像在蜜罐里泡了三天三夜一样甜！

say:12:1422010010:0.text: Where could the issue lie... Could it be...
say:12:1422010010:0.source_cn: 还是不行吗……到底是哪里出了问题？难道是……

choice_prompt:13:1422010010.text: Where could the issue lie... Could it be...
choice_prompt:13:1422010010.source_cn: 还是不行吗……到底是哪里出了问题？难道是……

say:14:1422010011:0.text: I never thought the machine could be the problem! I spent so much time researching and refining it...
say:14:1422010011:0.source_cn: 我之前从没想过是酿造器的问题！可是酿造器是我研究调试了...
say:14:1422010011:0.male: I never thought the machine could be the problem! I spent so much time researching and refining it...
say:14:1422010011:0.female: I never thought the machine could be the problem! I spent so much time researching and refining it...

say:15:1422010012:0.text: Is all my effort in vain?
say:15:1422010012:0.source_cn: 难道我花在它身上的时间都白费了……

say:16:1422010013:0.text: *Sigh* I'm such a failure. A real brewer wouldn't rely on a machine!
say:16:1422010013:0.source_cn: 唉，我真是个没用的家伙，真正的酿造师才不会想着借助这种东西！

say:17:1422010014:0.text: Is it the recipe? But all I added were basic ingredients like wheat extract, hops, and yeast. Plus, Zanie thought the flamefern leaves tasted good at first...
say:17:1422010014:0.source_cn: 是配方的问题吗……？可是我加的也不过是麦液、酒花、酵母...
say:17:1422010014:0.male: Is it the recipe? But all I added were basic ingredients like wheat extract, hops, and yeast. Plus, Zanie thought the flamefern leaves tasted good at first...
say:17:1422010014:0.female: Is it the recipe? But all I added were basic ingredients like wheat extract, hops, and yeast. Plus, Zanie thought the flamefern leaves tasted good at first...

say:18:1422010015:0.text: Creating a great drink that no one else has thought of? Yeah, that kind of luck's never on my side...
say:18:1422010015:0.source_cn: 果然，想出前人没想到的好喝配方……这种幸运是不会眷顾到...

say:20:1422010016:0.text: Don't lose heart just yet, Lavas! You need to figure out the real issue first!
say:20:1422010016:0.source_cn: 对嘛，别泄气，拉瓦斯！等你找到原因再泄气也不迟！

say:21:1422010017:0.text: How about letting <style="stress"><player_name></style> give your machine a go?
say:21:1422010017:0.male: How about letting <style="stress"><player_name></style> give your machine a go?
say:21:1422010017:0.female: How about letting <style="stress"><player_name></style> give your machine a go?

say:22:1422010018:1.text: Fair enough. Magister, it's pretty straightforward—just toss all the ingredients in and wait!
say:22:1422010018:1.male: Fair enough. Magister, it's pretty straightforward—just toss all the ingredients in and wait!
say:22:1422010018:1.female: Fair enough. Magister, it's pretty straightforward—just toss all the ingredients in and wait!

say:23:1422010019:0.text: I don't think I'm in a position to give you any tips. You can do it the way you like!
say:23:1422010019:0.source_cn: 以我的水平，已经没有自信教你什么了。请按照自己的喜好来吧！
say:23:1422010019:0.male: I don't think I'm in a position to give you any tips. You can do it the way you like!
say:23:1422010019:0.female: I don't think I'm in a position to give you any tips. You can do it the way you like!

say:24:1422010020:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't stress about it. Just have fun with the machine!

say:24:1422010020:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't stress about it. Just have fun with the machine!

say:25:1422010021:0.text: Go ahead and try as many times as you like! These ingredients won't put a dent in Lavas' pocket.
say:25:1422010021:0.source_cn: 失败了就多试几次，拉瓦斯不会舍不得这点材料的！
